protocol: Matched seed-7 simulations: identical initial state, measurement-noise stream, pretrained neural policy, MPPI settings, and zero initial learned correction. All enable dynamics learning and policy adaptation during flight, with no preliminary data collection. Gatekeeper admits controller updates only with an accepted candidate. The changed settings are the hidden drag/bias and whether Gatekeeper is enabled. This is one matched experiment, not a multi-seed performance claim. A lap is eight ordered gates. Clearance includes the simulated drone radius.
